name: Ai
line: Ai was a Canaanite city east of Bethel, near where Abram once camped and where Israel first lost, then won, a battle under Joshua.

moments.title: Abram camps near Ai
moments.text: Abram pitched his tent in the hill country with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on His name.

moments.title: Israel is defeated at Ai
moments.text: Joshua sent spies to Ai, and about three thousand men went up to attack. They fled before the men of Ai, and the people's hearts melted like water.

moments.title: The ambush and the fall of Ai
moments.text: The men of Ai chased Israel and left their city wide open. Joshua held out his battle lance as the LORD said, and the hidden men captured and burned the city.

moments.title: Ai becomes a heap of ruins
moments.text: Israel defeated the people of Ai and took the king alive. Joshua burned the city and made it a permanent heap of ruins.
